Tap to allow location for speed and weather
Tap to allow notification access to show music
Assistant is coming soon. Long-press Apps to open Settings and give this button an app.
Automatic switches to light from sunrise to sunset.
Connect to My Phone on Wake-Up
Turns Wi-Fi on and joins your phone\'s hotspot when the car starts.
On iPhone: Settings → Personal Hotspot → turn on \"Allow Others to Join\" and \"Maximise Compatibility\" (this unit only sees 2.4 GHz).
Opens the unit\'s Bluetooth app; turn on auto-connect there.
Open CarPlay When iPhone Is Plugged In
Turn on only if the CarPlay app doesn\'t open by itself.

Kokpit shows the calendars synced on this unit. For iCloud: 1) create an app-specific password at account.apple.com, 2) install DAVx⁵ and add an account with URL https://caldav.icloud.com, your Apple ID email and that password, 3) pick your calendars and turn on sync.
Tap to turn on Wi-Fi and join your phone
When off, short stops under 30 minutes skip the video.
Videos are copied to the unit, so you can remove the USB stick afterwards. MP4 (H.264), up to 20 MB; 3–8 seconds at 1024×600 looks best.
Some files were skipped: only MP4 videos up to 20 MB can be added.
The saved hotspot password can\'t be read anymore. Enter it again and tap Save.
Kokpit settings, system tools and diagnostics
No MP4 videos were found on the USB stick or SD card. Check that it is plugged in and allow storage access.
Saved to the USB stick: Android › data › io.github.yorulmazsinan.kokpit › files › kokpit-diagnostics.txt
Couldn\'t copy vendor apps. Plug in a USB stick and try again.
Kokpit\'s own Phone, Bluetooth Music and Radio screens. The dock buttons keep opening the unit\'s screens until radio and Bluetooth controls are connected.
No calls yet. They appear here when the unit records them.
No contacts. Sync your phone book from the unit\'s Bluetooth settings.
Preview: tuning is not connected to the radio yet. Tap here to open the unit\'s radio.
Empty preset, hold to save the current station
Waiting for location — tap to retry
Use Kokpit\'s Phone, Music and Radio
When off, the buttons open the unit\'s own screens.
The unit\'s radio service isn\'t available. Tap here to open the unit\'s radio.
Allow Kokpit to change system settings once to set the brightness here.
Nothing found. Plug in a USB stick or SD card with music or videos.
The picture is off while driving; the sound keeps playing.
Music and video from USB and SD card
Add your API key for Claude, OpenAI or Gemini in Settings to use the assistant.
Kokpit needs the microphone to hear you.
This unit has no speech recogniser. Install or update the Google app from the Play Store.
The assistant uses your own API key; it is stored encrypted on this unit and sent only to the provider you pick. A ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini subscription does not include API use.
Listens once more for a follow-up; say "tamam" to finish.
Turkish voice not installed — tap to install
No CarPlay app found on this unit
Neither the firmware\'s own CarPlay nor ZLink/AutoKit is installed.
Built into the firmware – no ZLink needed, starts fastest
Separate app using the unit\'s Apple chip
For a Carlinkit USB adapter (the adapter does CarPlay)
Direct mode: when the iPhone is plugged in, Kokpit opens the engine selected here itself – the firmware\'s own CarPlay is preferred over ZLink.
Screens of the selected engine. Tap one to try it; if it opens straight into CarPlay, it stays as the CarPlay target and the \"Loading…\" screen is skipped from then on.

The iPhone only starts CarPlay after the head unit proves itself with Apple\'s authentication chip (MFi). Talking to that chip and streaming CarPlay is done by the firmware\'s CarPlay service, ZLink or a Carlinkit adapter; an ordinary app cannot replace them. Kokpit uses the most direct one available.
Return to the stock screen, safe mode, reset
Safe mode is on because Kokpit crashed several times in a row. Home now opens the manufacturer\'s screen.
Safe mode was turned on by the KOKPIT-KURTARMA file on the USB stick.
Safe mode is on. Home opens the manufacturer\'s screen.
Return the unit to how it was
Safe mode on, Home choice cleared, animations restored, manufacturer screen opened
Forgets \"Kokpit → Always\"; pick the manufacturer\'s screen next
Kokpit starts nothing in the background and Home goes to the manufacturer\'s screen. Turning it off restarts Kokpit.
Theme, dock, hotspot, API keys, presets – back to first install
All Kokpit settings will be deleted and Kokpit will restart. Intro videos are kept.
Back to the values before Kokpit changed them
Turn switched-off apps back on, one by one
Kokpit does not touch firmware; after removal the unit works as before
Ways in when the screen is broken

• Long-press the clock on the home screen.
• An empty file named KOKPIT-KURTARMA on a USB stick's root: safe mode + manufacturer screen. KOKPIT-SIFIRLA resets Kokpit, KOKPIT-NORMAL leaves safe mode. A report (KOKPIT-KURTARMA-SONUC.txt) is written back to the stick.
• Three crashes within three minutes turn on safe mode by themselves.
• From a computer: araclar/geri-al.sh (or .bat) undoes every ADB speed-up.
Free memory, faster animations, unnecessary apps
%1$d MB free of %2$d MB · closes only idle background apps
Animation speed needs a one-time permission from a computer:\nadb shell pm grant %1$s android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS\n(araclar/hizlandir.sh does this for you.)
Known apps that are useless in a car. Tap one and press \"Disable\" (or \"Force stop\"). Nothing is deleted; it can be turned back on from the list below.
None left – all known unnecessary apps are off.
Tap one and press \"Enable\" to bring it back.
Plays the built-in summer or winter welcome clip: by outside temperature (≤10 °C winter, ≥18 °C summer), otherwise by month (November–March winter).
Dims at sunset, brightens at sunrise. A change with the ☀ button holds until the next sunset or sunrise.
Only the speedometer stays lit after dark (Classic Cockpit theme). A tap brings everything back.
Sunrise and sunset come from the weather for your location; without it 07:00 and 19:00 are used.
Scan with your phone before leaving the car
Saved automatically when the ignition goes off.
One-tap navigation from the home screen
On the home screen tap Home or Work to start navigation in your maps app. Long-press saves the car\'s current spot.
Odometer must be higher than the last entry
No fill-ups yet. Enter the odometer, liters and amount from the receipt at each fill-up; consumption appears after two full tanks.
Fuel fill-ups and km log of every drive
Every drive from ignition on to off is logged here by itself (GPS).
Resume music when the ignition comes on
Radio, Bluetooth music or the app that was playing starts again. Music paused before stopping stays paused; not while CarPlay is plugged in.
When parked and untouched, the home screen turns into a large clock with date and temperature. A touch or driving off brings it back.
Android asks once to allow installing from Kokpit: turn on \"Allow from this source\", come back and press Install again.
When online, at ignition-on, at most every six hours. Installing always needs your tap.
Android installs only versions signed with the same key as this one. If a new version misbehaves, safe mode (3 crashes) or the USB recovery file returns the unit to the stock screen.
Copy kokpit.apk to a USB stick\'s root and plug it in
No newer Kokpit APK on the USB stick (kokpit*.apk on the root or in the Kokpit folder).
%1$d left · tap: the next one\'s page opens, press \"Disable\" and come back
Tap: Developer options open. Set \"Window\", \"Transition\" and \"Animator\" scale to 0.5×, then come back
Developer options are hidden: tap \"Build number\" 7 times on this page, then press this step again.
Tap and allow: Android won\'t stop Kokpit\'s background service (resume, parking, trips)

Kokpit connects to this unit\'s own debugging service (only inside the unit, never over the network) and does the whole speed-up in one tap. Android asks once on screen: tick \"Always allow\" and confirm. Kokpit never installs anything this way.
Not available on this unit right now: \"USB debugging\" is off or the unit doesn\'t offer it. The steps above work without it.
Switches off all unnecessary apps, sets animations to 0.5×, compiles Kokpit ahead of time (faster start), keeps Kokpit awake. Recorded, fully reversible.
Working… if Android asks \"Allow USB debugging?\", tick \"Always allow\" and confirm.
Done: %1$d apps switched off (%2$d could not be).
Undo: turn those apps back on
When finished, switch \"USB debugging\" off in Developer options. Everything Kokpit changed stays as it is.
Also: Developer options → \"Revoke USB debugging authorisations\"
Some units open their own home screen at every start; Kokpit then comes back to the front by itself.
If the unit pushes its own home screen to the front (reversing camera, start-up), Kokpit comes back. Radio, maps and other apps you open are left alone.
Needed to see that the unit\'s own home screen is in front. Tap → Kokpit → Allow.
%1$s · time zone %2$s · tap for Android\'s date settings

This unit has no clock battery and starts on 1 August after every power-off. Kokpit sets its clock from GPS (under open sky), the internet (hotspot on) or the moment CarPlay sets Android\'s clock, and keeps it right while the unit is on. Until then it shows an estimate, marked ≈. If the hour is off by whole hours, set the time zone (e.g. Europe/Berlin) in Android\'s date settings.
Switch phone; automatic switch at ignition-on
Tap a phone to connect it (the current one is let go). At ignition-on, if no phone connects within 10 seconds, Kokpit tries the paired phones in turn, most recently used first.
No paired phones visible to Android. On some units Bluetooth lives in a separate module that only the unit\'s own Phone app can control.
Connecting to %1$s… (up to 15 s; the phone\'s Bluetooth must be on)
%1$s did not connect. Is its Bluetooth on and nearby? If this keeps failing, the unit does not let apps switch phones; then pick the car from the phone\'s own Bluetooth menu.
Browser button and photo instead of the speedometer
Add a photo or pick a browser — tap
Tap the card to open it full screen. Brave is used when installed; tap here for another browser or app.
Scan the code with the phone that is the unit\'s hotspot, pick a photo. Works on iPhone and Android, no app needed.
Sending closed (5 minutes passed). Tap again to reopen.
The unit is not on a network. Connect it to the phone\'s hotspot first.
Photos on a USB stick or SD card, or downloaded with the browser
No photos found. Download one with the browser or put it on a USB stick.
Not a photo Kokpit can read
Turns the selected photo a quarter clockwise
No photos yet. Every photo you send or choose is kept here.
Tap a photo to show it on the card. Up to 30 photos are kept; the oldest goes when a new one comes.
Deletes the selected photo from the album
estimate — waiting for GPS, internet or CarPlay
≈ estimated time · waiting for GPS / internet / CarPlay
Scan with the phone on the unit\'s hotspot. The report opens there with Copy and Download buttons; paste it into the chat. The page closes after 10 minutes or when you leave this screen.
Photos, fuel log, home/work and the report from your phone
Use the phone that is the unit\'s hotspot. The panel opens in its browser: add photos, pick the card photo, enter fuel, set home/work, read the report.
Opens only with this QR (new each time) and your PIN; 5 wrong PINs lock it for a while. Closes after 15 minutes unused or 1 hour in any case. It can\'t install apps or change system settings.
Phone panel open · tap to close
Theme, colours, brightness, Night Panel, clock
Home/Work, logbook, Bluetooth phones, home card, music resume, stand-by
Summer/winter clips, your own videos, calendar
Which app each bottom button opens
Kokpit\'s own phone, music and radio screens
No hotspot? The unit opens its own Wi-Fi (no internet) just for the panel
The unit is on no network. Tap \"Kokpit\'s own Wi-Fi\": the unit opens its own network, no hotspot needed.
Scan with the phone camera: it joins by itself
Or by hand: %1$s · password %2$s. The phone keeps its mobile data.
The panel opens in the phone\'s browser and asks for your 4-digit PIN.
First connection: the panel asks you to choose a 4-digit PIN. From then on it asks for it every time.
Forgot it? The next connection sets a new one
The PIN is forgotten; the next phone that connects sets a new one. Only possible here, on the unit.
Or scan it with the Kokpit Kumanda app: no Wi-Fi needed, it connects over Bluetooth.
The unit is on no Wi-Fi: this QR opens only in the Kokpit Kumanda app (Bluetooth). For the phone\'s browser, tap \"Kokpit\'s own Wi-Fi\".
Kokpit Kumanda can\'t connect this time: %1$s
%1$s wants to connect to the Kokpit panel.
%1$s (remembered phone) wants to connect to the Kokpit panel.
Connect without the PIN and can send routes and photos with Share → Kokpit. Tap to forget.
Forget %1$s? The PIN will be asked next time.
Or just tap Connect in Kokpit Kumanda: no QR, the unit asks to Allow.
Enter dates as DD.MM.YYYY. Reminded 30 days (1,000 km for oil) ahead on the home screen and in the phone panel. Km come from the fuel log.
Home/work, photo, music and brightness follow the phone connected over Bluetooth
For wireless Android Auto/CarPlay, turn the phone\'s hotspot off: while it is on, the phone can\'t join the unit\'s network.
Wireless Android Auto/CarPlay: the phone\'s hotspot must be off, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on. Kokpit doesn\'t pull the unit onto the hotspot while ZLink is in front.
